fields.symptom: 图形故障(损坏、闪烁、缺少纹理)
fields.repro:
1. Launch the game. 
2. The game begins loading.
3. After the game window appears, the copyright notice fails to display. 
4. The opening‑screen dashboard is shown; with frame‑synchronization enabled, the visuals run smoothly, but when it’s disabled, the frame rate stutters. 5. Upon successfully reaching the main menu, the video playback stutters. Prior to this, when preparing to enter the game, the audio responds first, followed by the graphics rendering; once the visuals are rendered, the audio also starts stuttering in sync with the video. 
6. Click “Start Game” (set to the lowest graphics settings). 
7. The game displays a message: “Optimizing your PC.” The loading‑screen background image does not appear and instead shows colored streaks. During the loading process, between 4% and 10%, an error may occur at any point within that range. The primary error message is: “Assertion failed. vkCreateShaderModule.”
